items.en: Lucas wrote a song for his wife.
items.zh: 盧卡斯寫了一首歌給他太太。

items.en: Those people are fighting for their freedom.
items.zh: 那些人是為了他們的自由而戰。

items.en: For some reason, Nora decided not to study abroad.
items.zh: 基於某些原因，諾拉決定不出國念書。

items.en: Are you for or against the proposal?
items.zh: 你是贊成或反對本提案？

items.en: Jerry decided to stop for lunch first, for he was feeling hungry.
items.zh: 傑瑞決定先停下來吃午餐，因為他肚子餓了。

items.en: I like Jeremy because he is polite.
items.zh: 我喜歡傑瑞米，因為他很有禮貌。

items.en: Because Jeremy is polite, I like him.
items.zh: 因為傑瑞米很有禮貌，所以我喜歡他。

items.en: Because of COVID-19, we couldn’t travel abroad.
items.zh: 由於新冠肺炎，我們無法出國旅行。

grammar.q: because of 後面應接什麼？
grammar.explain: because of + 名詞／V-ing；because + 子句。

grammar.q: I like Jeremy ___ he is polite.
grammar.explain: because + 子句（主詞＋動詞）。

grammar.q: Are you ___ or against the plan?
grammar.explain: be for＝贊成；be against＝反對。

items.en: I will arrive in New York tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 明早我將會抵達紐約。

items.en: I’ll arrive in New York tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 明早我將會抵達紐約。（縮寫句）

items.en: Nobody can question Stanley’s will to win.
items.zh: 沒有人可以質疑史坦利的求勝意志。

items.en: You can’t just ignore the rules at will.
items.zh: 你不能隨意忽略這些規定。

items.en: The man made his final will a month before he died.
items.zh: 這名男子在去世前一個月立下最後的遺囑。

grammar.q: 下列哪一個表示「隨意地」？
grammar.explain: at will＝隨意地；against one’s will＝違背意願。

grammar.q: will 後面要接？
grammar.explain: will + 原形動詞，表示未來。

grammar.q: I will 的縮寫是？
grammar.explain: I will＝I’ll。

items.en: Can you speak French?
items.zh: 你會說法文嗎？

items.en: You can’t talk loudly in the library.
items.zh: 在圖書館內不能大聲喧嘩。

items.en: You cannot talk loudly in the library.
items.zh: 在圖書館內不能大聲喧嘩。（完整形式）

items.en: Matthew drank ten cans of soda at the party.
items.zh: 馬修在派對上喝了十罐汽水。

items.en: My mother always cans fruit at the end of the summer.
items.zh: 每年夏末，我母親總是把水果製成罐頭。

grammar.q: can 後面要接哪一種動詞形式？
grammar.explain: 情態助動詞 can 後接原形動詞。

grammar.q: can not 的縮寫是？
grammar.explain: cannot＝can’t。

grammar.q: My mom cans fruit. 這裡的 cans 是？
grammar.explain: can 當一般動詞＝裝罐，主詞第三人稱單數要加 s。

items.en: Time passes quickly when you’re having fun.
items.zh: 玩樂時，時間過得特別快。

items.en: Nate goes to the gym three times a week.
items.zh: 奈特一週上健身房三次。

items.en: John didn’t have time to prepare for the test.
items.zh: 約翰沒有時間來準備考試。

items.en: Take your time with the meal; there’s no rush.
items.zh: 你可以慢慢用餐，不用急。

items.en: I’m afraid that you have to share your room for the time being.
items.zh: 恐怕你得暫時跟別人合住一間房。

items.en: Luke finished the job in no time and left.
items.zh: 路克很快地把工作做完就離開了。

items.en: The train arrived at the station on time.
items.zh: 火車準時到站。

items.en: Will you be here in time for the concert?
items.zh: 你來得及趕來聽這場演唱會嗎？

items.en: My parents come to Taipei to see me from time to time.
items.zh: 我父母偶爾會來臺北看我。

items.en: Tom timed his visit to suit Judy’s convenience.
items.zh: 湯姆選在茱蒂方便的時候去拜訪她。

grammar.q: 哪個片語代表「準時」？
grammar.explain: on time＝準時；in time＝及時；in no time＝很快地。

grammar.q: 「及時（趕上）」是哪一個？
grammar.explain: in time＝及時；on time＝準時。

grammar.q: from time to time 意思是？
grammar.explain: from time to time＝偶爾、有時。

items.en: Do you know who took my book?
items.zh: 你知道誰拿走我的書嗎？

items.en: Eric took his children to the amusement park.
items.zh: 艾瑞克帶他的小孩到遊樂園。

items.en: Grace takes a bus to work every day.
items.zh: 葛瑞絲每天搭公車去上班。

items.en: It took me five hours to finish the book.
items.zh: 我花了五個小時看完那本書。

grammar.q: 「花某人時間做某事」是哪一種句型？
choices: It takes sb + 時間 + to V
It takes sb + 時間 + V-ing
grammar.explain: It takes sb + 時間 + to V。

grammar.q: Grace ___ a bus to work every day.
grammar.explain: 主詞第三人稱單數，現在式動詞加 s。

grammar.q: take 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: take – took – taken。

items.en: Add the milk, and then stir the soup for five minutes.
items.zh: 加入牛奶，接著攪拌湯五分鐘。

items.en: Mr. Brown was a famous singer then.
items.zh: 布朗先生當時是位知名歌手。

items.en: The whole system has changed since then.
items.zh: 從那時起整個系統就改變了。

items.en: We still get together every now and then after all these years.
items.zh: 過了這些年，我們有時還會聚在一起。

items.en: If you want to lose weight, then you have to eat less.
items.zh: 如果你想減肥，那麼就得少吃一點。

items.en: In 1941, America’s then president declared war on Japan.
items.zh: 1941 年，當時的美國總統向日本宣戰。

grammar.q: every now and then 是什麼意思？
grammar.explain: every now and then＝有時；since then＝從那時起。

grammar.q: since then 意思是？
grammar.explain: since then＝從那時起，常搭配完成式。

grammar.q: If you want to lose weight, ___ you have to eat less.
grammar.explain: If…, then…＝如果…那麼…；than 用於比較。

items.en: This book is about music.
items.zh: 這是一本有關音樂的書。

items.en: The bus will leave in about ten minutes.
items.zh: 公車大約再過十分鐘就要開走了。

items.en: Ron was about ready to leave, but his wife wasn’t.
items.zh: 榮恩幾乎準備好要出發了，但他太太還沒好。

items.en: The principal is about to arrive.
items.zh: 校長快要到了。

grammar.q: be about to V 表示什麼？
grammar.explain: be about to + 原形動詞，表示即將。

grammar.q: about ten minutes 的 about 意思是？
grammar.explain: about + 數字＝大約。

grammar.q: This book is about music. 的 about 是？
grammar.explain: about + 主題＝關於。

items.en: The police still couldn’t find enough evidence.
items.zh: 警方還是無法找到足夠的證據。

items.en: You have to find out the answer by yourself.
items.zh: 你必須自己找出答案。

items.en: Cory found the TV show interesting.
items.zh: 柯瑞認為這檔電視節目很有趣。

items.en: Harry’s new home is great—it’s a real find!
items.zh: 哈利的新家真棒——能找到這種住所真不錯！

grammar.q: find out 的意思是？
grammar.explain: find out＝查明；find + 受詞 + 形容詞＝覺得某物如何。

grammar.q: Cory found the show ___.
grammar.explain: find + 受詞 + 形容詞＝覺得某物如何。

grammar.q: It’s a real find! 這裡的 find 是？
grammar.explain: find 作名詞＝意外發現的好東西。

items.en: I ran into Jenny on my way to the post office.
items.zh: 我去郵局的途中遇見了珍妮。

items.en: Keep on trying. Let nothing stand in your way.
items.zh: 繼續努力。別讓任何困難阻礙你。

items.en: Ted didn’t know which way to go.
items.zh: 泰德不知道要走哪邊。

items.en: We tried to think of some ways to fix the problem.
items.zh: 我們設法想出幾個辦法來解決這個問題。

items.en: You need to get used to the way he talks.
items.zh: 你得要習慣他的說話風格。

items.en: What you said is right in a way.
items.zh: 你所說的話就某方面而言是對的。

grammar.q: on one’s way to 表示？
grammar.explain: on one’s way to＝前往途中；in a way＝某方面。

grammar.q: in a way 意思是？
grammar.explain: in a way＝就某方面而言。

grammar.q: stand in one’s way 意思是？
grammar.explain: stand in one’s way＝阻礙某人。

items.en: We’re not friends; I don’t even know his name.
items.zh: 我們不是朋友；我甚至連他的名字都不知道。

items.en: I’ll give you the money even if you can’t pay me back.
items.zh: 即使你沒能力還錢，我還是會給你錢。

items.en: Even though he is poor, she still loves him.
items.zh: 雖然他窮，她仍愛他。

items.en: Gordy thought he had an even chance of winning.
items.zh: 高迪認為自己也有同等獲勝的機會。

items.en: The floor was not even, and I almost fell.
items.zh: 這地面不平，我差點跌倒。

items.en: Even numbers can be divided exactly by 2.
items.zh: 偶數可被 2 整除。

items.en: With the goal, Ben evened the game at 3-3.
items.zh: 班射門得分，讓比賽以 3 比 3 打平。

grammar.q: even though 後面通常接？
grammar.explain: even though＝雖然；even if＝即使，後面都可接子句。

grammar.q: even numbers 是指？
grammar.explain: even 作形容詞可指偶數、平坦的。

grammar.q: I don’t ___ know his name.
grammar.explain: even＝甚至，用來加強語氣。

items.en: You can use your smartphone to listen to podcasts.
items.zh: 你可以用智慧型手機來聽播客。

items.en: Sharon uses her garage as an office.
items.zh: 雪倫把她的車庫當作辦公室來使用。

items.en: I thought that his advice was of great use.
items.zh: 我認為他的忠告很有用。

items.en: I thought that his advice was very useful.
items.zh: 我認為他的忠告很有用。

items.en: This online map is very useful for driving.
items.zh: 這個線上地圖對開車非常有用。

items.en: I think it’s useless to try to fix this machine.
items.zh: 我認為修理這部機器是沒有用的。

grammar.q: use A as B 表示？
choices: 把 A 當作 B 使用
grammar.explain: use A as B＝把 A 當作 B 使用。

grammar.q: useful 的相反詞是？
grammar.explain: useful↔useless。

grammar.q: of great use 等於？
grammar.explain: of + 抽象名詞＝形容詞，of great use＝very useful。

items.en: Tim likes playing soccer very much.
items.zh: 提姆非常喜歡踢足球。

items.en: Tim likes to play soccer very much.
items.zh: 提姆非常喜歡踢足球。

items.en: I would like to see a movie tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚想去看場電影。

items.en: I feel like seeing a movie tonight.
items.zh: 我今晚想去看場電影。

items.en: At the zoo we saw pandas, tigers, lions, and the like.
items.zh: 在動物園，我們看到熊貓、老虎、獅子等等的動物。

items.en: Everyone has his own likes and dislikes.
items.zh: 人各有好惡。

items.en: Kate looks like her father.
items.zh: 凱特長得像她爸爸。

grammar.q: feel like 後面要接？
grammar.explain: feel like + V-ing＝想要做某事。

grammar.q: would like 後面接？
grammar.explain: would like + to V＝想要。

grammar.q: Kate looks like her father. 的 like 是？
grammar.explain: look like＝看起來像。

items.en: I think that this is an exceptional case.
items.zh: 我認為這是個例外的情形。

items.en: It was so noisy outside that I couldn’t think.
items.zh: 外面太吵了，吵到我無法思考。

items.en: Jessica is thinking about the story for her new novel.
items.zh: 潔西卡在想新小說的故事。

grammar.q: think about / of 後面可以接？
grammar.explain: think about/of + 名詞／V-ing。

grammar.q: I think ___ this is a special case.
grammar.explain: think that + 子句，that 可省略。

grammar.q: think 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: think – thought – thought。

items.en: You’ll have to make up your own mind.
items.zh: 你必須自己拿定主意。

items.en: Believe it or not, the guy has a plane of his own.
items.zh: 信不信由你，這傢伙有一架自己的飛機。

items.en: From now on, you’ll have to be on your own.
items.zh: 從今以後，你一切得靠自己了。

items.en: They don’t own the house—they rent it.
items.zh: 他們沒擁有這棟房子——他們是用租的。

grammar.q: on one’s own 表示？
grammar.explain: on one’s own＝獨立地；of one’s own＝某人自己的。

grammar.q: a plane of his own 意思是？
grammar.explain: of one’s own＝屬於某人自己的。

grammar.q: They don’t own the house. 的 own 是？
grammar.explain: own 作動詞＝擁有。

items.en: Joy thinks there is life on other planets.
items.zh: 喬伊認為其他星球上有生命。

items.en: The flood claimed 20 lives.
items.zh: 洪水奪走了 20 條人命。

items.en: Life is a long journey.
items.zh: 人生是一條漫長的旅程。

items.en: Aunt Joyce leads a simple life in the country.
items.zh: 喬伊絲阿姨過著簡樸的鄉間生活。

items.en: There is almost no life at all in that desert.
items.zh: 那個沙漠裡幾乎沒有生物。

grammar.q: lead a simple life 是指？
grammar.explain: lead/live a(n) + 形容詞 + life。

grammar.q: life 的複數是？
grammar.explain: 字尾 f(e) 常變 ves：life → lives。

grammar.q: claim 20 lives 意思是？
grammar.explain: claim lives＝奪走人命。

items.en: People cannot live long without water.
items.zh: 沒有水的話，人活不了多久。

items.en: Susan lives next door to me.
items.zh: 蘇珊住在我隔壁。

items.en: Gail lives a happy life with her husband.
items.zh: 蓋兒和她老公過著快樂的生活。

items.en: The cat was playing with a live mouse.
items.zh: 這隻貓正在玩一隻活生生的老鼠。

items.en: We went to see a live band last night.
items.zh: 昨晚我們去看了現場樂團的表演。

grammar.q: live band 的 live 是？
grammar.explain: live /laɪv/ 作形容詞可指「現場的」。

grammar.q: Susan lives next door. 的 live 唸成？
grammar.explain: 動詞 live（居住）唸 /lɪv/；形容詞 live（現場的）唸 /laɪv/。

grammar.q: live a happy life 的 live 是？
grammar.explain: live a(n) + adj. + life＝過…的生活。

items.en: I just saw Eric leave the office.
items.zh: 我剛才看到艾瑞克離開辦公室。

items.en: Amanda came just as I was leaving.
items.zh: 我正好要離開時，亞曼達就來了。

items.en: I’m just looking; I don’t want to buy anything today.
items.zh: 我只是看一看，今天不想買東西。

items.en: The weather is just marvelous.
items.zh: 天氣真是非常棒。

items.en: Just a minute. I’ll be right back.
items.zh: 請等一下，我馬上就回來。

items.en: We all think that the judge made a just decision.
items.zh: 我們都認為這名法官做了一個公正的決定。

grammar.q: just a minute 表示？
grammar.explain: just a minute＝稍等；just 也可作「剛剛」「只是」。

grammar.q: a just decision 的 just 是？
grammar.explain: just 作形容詞＝公正的。

grammar.q: I just saw Eric. 的 just 是？
grammar.explain: just 作副詞可表「剛剛」。

items.en: The post office is between the bank and the grocery store.
items.zh: 郵局位在銀行和雜貨店的中間。

items.en: We have two meetings this afternoon, with a break in between.
items.zh: 我們下午有兩場會議，中間會休息一次。

grammar.q: between A and B 應如何使用？
choices: 在 A 與 B 之間
在 A 和 B 之後
grammar.explain: between A and B＝在 A 和 B 之間；in between＝在中間。

grammar.q: between 通常用於幾者之間？
grammar.explain: between 用於兩者之間；三者以上常用 among。

grammar.q: with a break in between 的 in between 是？
grammar.explain: in between＝在中間。

items.en: I’ve eaten five hamburgers, but I’m still hungry.
items.zh: 我已經吃了五個漢堡，但還是很餓。

items.en: Although Kate got good grades, her parents asked her to study still harder.
items.zh: 雖然凱特成績很好，她父母叫她還要更努力。

items.en: Keep still while I take your picture.
items.zh: 我幫你拍照時，請保持不動。

grammar.q: still 在一般肯定句的位置通常是？
grammar.explain: still 通常放一般動詞前；若為 be 動詞，放在 be 後。

grammar.q: Keep still. 的 still 是？
grammar.explain: still 作形容詞＝靜止的。

grammar.q: study still harder 的 still 是？
grammar.explain: still + 比較級＝更加。

items.en: Ted ordered another drink for himself.
items.zh: 泰德為自己再點了一杯飲料。

items.en: I just watched a film, and I’ll probably watch another.
items.zh: 我剛看完一部電影，有可能會再看一部。

items.en: They gave one another presents at Christmas.
items.zh: 他們在聖誕節期間彼此互送禮物。

grammar.q: one another 表示？
grammar.explain: one another＝彼此；another＝另一個。

grammar.q: another 後面接？
grammar.explain: another + 單數可數名詞＝另一個。

grammar.q: another drink 意思是？
grammar.explain: another＝再一個、另一個。

items.en: My grandmother used to work for a publisher.
items.zh: 我奶奶曾替一間出版社工作。

items.en: The machine doesn’t work.
items.zh: 這機器故障了無法運作。

items.en: I’m glad this method works!
items.zh: 我很高興這個方法行得通！

items.en: They teamed up and worked out the problem.
items.zh: 他們合作解決了這個問題。

items.en: Vanessa is looking for work now.
items.zh: 凡妮莎正在找工作。

items.en: The artist’s works are on display at the gallery.
items.zh: 這名藝術家的作品正在藝廊展出。

items.en: There are thousands of workers in the factory.
items.zh: 工廠裡有數千名工人。

items.en: Terry gets along well with his coworkers.
items.zh: 泰瑞跟同事們處得很好。

grammar.q: work out a problem 的意思是？
grammar.explain: work out＝解決；look for work＝找工作。

grammar.q: The machine doesn’t work. 的 work 是？
grammar.explain: work 可指機器運作、方法行得通。

grammar.q: The artist’s works 的 works 是？
grammar.explain: work 作可數名詞＝作品。

items.en: If you do your duties well, you’ll be rewarded.
items.zh: 如果好好盡你的職責，你就會得到獎賞。

items.en: I don’t feel well today, so I’ll call in sick.
items.zh: 我今天身體不舒服，所以我會打電話請病假。

items.en: The oil well has gone dry, so we’ll have to find another one.
items.zh: 這座油井枯竭了，我們必須找另一座。

grammar.q: well 可以表示哪一項？
grammar.explain: well 可作副詞、形容詞，也可作名詞「井」。

grammar.q: I don’t feel well. 的 well 是？
grammar.explain: feel well＝身體舒服，well 作形容詞＝健康的。

grammar.q: good 的副詞是？
grammar.explain: good（形容詞）→ well（副詞）。

items.en: How did Martin do on the test last week?
items.zh: 馬丁上週的考試成績如何？

items.en: How well the girl sings!
items.zh: 這女孩唱得多麼好聽啊！

items.en: How come the little boy is crying?
items.zh: 小男孩為什麼在哭？

grammar.q: How come 後面常用什麼語序？
grammar.explain: How come + 主詞 + 動詞，通常不倒裝。

grammar.q: How well the girl sings! 是什麼句型？
grammar.explain: How + 形容詞/副詞 + 主詞 + 動詞！＝感嘆句。

grammar.q: How did Martin do on the test? 是在問？
grammar.explain: How did sb do on…？＝某人…表現得如何？

items.en: A great fire burned down the house.
items.zh: 大火燒毀了那棟房子。

items.en: Gandhi was a great man.
items.zh: 甘地是個偉大的人物。

items.en: Peter just came up with a great idea.
items.zh: 彼得剛剛想出一個很棒的點子。

items.en: Chopin is one of the all-time greats in music.
items.zh: 蕭邦是有史以來最偉大的音樂家之一。

grammar.q: one of the all-time greats 是指？
grammar.explain: great 作名詞（常用複數）可指偉人。

grammar.q: a great fire 的 great 是？
grammar.explain: great 可指規模大。

grammar.q: come up with 意思是？
grammar.explain: come up with an idea＝想出點子。

items.en: Mark thanked his friends for helping him move.
items.zh: 馬克感謝他的朋友幫他搬家。

items.en: Tina bought Ellie a meal to show her thanks.
items.zh: 蒂娜請艾麗吃一頓飯以表達感謝。

items.en: Nancy felt sorry about forgetting Bob’s birthday.
items.zh: 南希很抱歉忘了鮑伯的生日。

items.en: Ricky was sorry that he broke Vicky’s toy.
items.zh: 瑞奇對摔壞薇琪的玩具感到抱歉。

items.en: Kelly was sorry to hear Tony’s dog died.
items.zh: 凱莉聽到東尼的狗去世很難過。

grammar.q: thank sb for 後面可以接？
grammar.explain: thank sb for + 名詞／V-ing。

grammar.q: be sorry about 後面接？
grammar.explain: be sorry about + 名詞／V-ing。

grammar.q: to show one’s thanks 的 thanks 是？
grammar.explain: thanks 作名詞＝謝意。

items.en: Dean ate breakfast quickly and then left home.
items.zh: 狄恩快速吃了早餐後離開家裡。

items.en: Barbara told her kids it was time to eat.
items.zh: 芭芭拉告訴她小孩吃飯的時間到了。

items.en: Ian doesn’t eat out often because it’s expensive.
items.zh: 伊恩不常外出用餐，因為費用昂貴。

items.en: Greg drank a lot of water on the hot day.
items.zh: 葛瑞格在那個大熱天喝了很多水。

items.en: Wayne didn’t want anything to drink.
items.zh: 韋恩不想喝任何東西。

items.en: Jolene’s favorite drink is orange juice with ice.
items.zh: 喬琳最喜歡的飲料是加冰塊的柳橙汁。

grammar.q: eat out 是什麼意思？
grammar.explain: eat out＝外出用餐；eat in＝在家吃飯。

grammar.q: eat 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: eat – ate – eaten。

grammar.q: drink 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: drink – drank – drunk。

items.en: Riley was so hungry he ate all the pizza.
items.zh: 雷利太餓了，所以他吃了一整個披薩。

items.en: All Minnie’s teachers think that she is smart.
items.zh: 米妮的老師都認為她很聰明。

items.en: Freda watched TV all alone in her living room.
items.zh: 芙蕾達自己一人在客廳看電視。

items.en: Noah doesn’t like carrots at all.
items.zh: 諾亞一點都不喜歡紅蘿蔔。

items.en: All Paul had in his pocket was a dollar.
items.zh: 保羅口袋裡所有的東西僅是一美元。

grammar.q: not ... at all 表示？
grammar.explain: not ... at all＝一點也不；all alone＝獨自一人。

grammar.q: all alone 意思是？
grammar.explain: all alone＝獨自一人。

grammar.q: All Paul had was a dollar. 意思是？
grammar.explain: All + 主詞 + 動詞 + was…＝某人所有的只有…。

items.en: Gloria decided to exercise and become healthy.
items.zh: 葛洛莉亞決定要運動變得健康。

items.en: Oscar became an actor after graduating from college.
items.zh: 奧斯卡從大學畢業後成為一名演員。

grammar.q: become 後面接形容詞表示？
grammar.explain: become + adj. 表示狀態改變。

grammar.q: become 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: become – became – become。

grammar.q: become an actor 的 become 後面接？
grammar.explain: become + 名詞／形容詞。

items.en: Roy told his mom he wanted to be a doctor.
items.zh: 洛伊告訴他媽媽他想成為一名醫生。

items.en: Clark told his daughter about her grandfather.
items.zh: 克萊克告訴他女兒有關她爺爺的事。

items.en: Sally could tell that her boss was mad.
items.zh: 莎莉看得出來她的老闆很火大。

grammar.q: tell sb about sth 是指？
grammar.explain: tell sb about sth＝告訴某人有關某事。

grammar.q: Sally could tell that… 的 tell 是？
grammar.explain: can tell＝分辨、看得出來。

grammar.q: tell 的過去式是？
grammar.explain: tell – told – told。

items.en: Roger asked his teacher if he could go home early.
items.zh: 羅傑詢問老師他是否可以早點回家。

items.en: Bobby asked his father to buy him a bike.
items.zh: 巴比請他爸爸買一臺腳踏車給他。

items.en: Carmen asked for help from her coworker.
items.zh: 卡門向她的同事尋求協助。

items.en: Willy finally asked Fiona out to dinner.
items.zh: 威利終於邀請費歐娜共進晚餐。

grammar.q: ask sb to V 表示？
grammar.explain: ask sb to + 原形動詞；ask for help＝求助。

grammar.q: ask sb out 意思是？
grammar.explain: ask sb out＝邀請某人外出（約會）。

grammar.q: ask if… 的 if 意思是？
grammar.explain: ask if + 子句＝詢問是否…。
